scope: Pinned private Moshi training/runtime environment only; not the general application environment.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: Pinned Moshi requires aiohttp>=3.10.5,<3.12; the available fixes begin outside that range.
mitigations: Do not expose the pinned training environment as a public service.
Bind any later research server to loopback or a trusted authenticated network only.
Re-evaluate and remove this exception before deployment or an upstream Moshi migration.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: Pinned Moshi requires sentencepiece==0.2; the published fix is 0.2.1.
mitigations: Load only the SHA-256-pinned Moshika SentencePiece model.
Never parse participant-provided or other untrusted tokenizer model files.
Re-evaluate and remove this exception before deployment or an upstream Moshi migration.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: Pinned Moshi-Finetune requires torch==2.6 and pinned Moshi requires torch<2.7; fixes are outside the supported range or unavailable.
mitigations: Load only SHA-256-pinned safetensors and project-generated checkpoints; never torch.load untrusted files.
Use the isolated environment for local single-GPU research, not public multi-tenant inference.
Treat audio, captions, network messages, and model files from outside the frozen corpus as untrusted.
Re-evaluate and remove this exception before deployment or an upstream trainer migration.
